name: Llama 3.1 8B
context_scaling: llama3 rope scaling (factor 8 from an 8192 base)
notes: PARAMS: 8.03B is the safetensors count (8B nominal). KV: 32 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 131,072 bytes/token = 128 KiB/token. This is the reference point for how much GQA bought: at 8k context it is 1.0 GiB per sequence; the same 8k on a 32-head MHA model would be 4x that. head_dim is not set explicitly in config.json; 4096/32 = 128 is the HF-implied value and is what the KV arithmetic uses. SOURCE CAVEAT: Meta's own Hugging Face repo is gated (HTTP 401 unauthenticated). These config values come from the NousResearch mirror of the same weights, which is not a first-party URL.
